semantics.definition: Clay, a character of the old No Origins project, made with Meshy.ai: his model and his look, as small copies, and the element of the 3D world they make, drawn by the world’s three.js as tall as a character is. He stands plainly, legs straight and arms down, or walks or runs on his place. The character chosen for now.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one clay every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Be a person in the 3D world.

state.standing: standing plainly on his place, legs straight, arms down at his sides
state.walking: walking on the spot, with the walk his model carries
state.running: running on the spot, with the run his model carries
